title: Orchestrator restarts a stuck replica via the liveness probe without external dependency coupling
asA: orchestrator running the deployed application under a supervising process (Kubernetes kubelet, systemd, or equivalent)
iWant: a liveness endpoint that answers pass or fail strictly on whether the process is running its event loop
soThat: I restart a wedged replica without letting a downstream dependency outage cascade into a restart storm across every replica

acceptanceCriteria.description: The application serves the liveness endpoint at a stable HTTP path declared in configuration (default /healthz); a GET returns 200 when the process is running its event loop and returns application/json with a status field equal to pass.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the process is running normally with its event loop responsive
acceptanceCriteria.when: an unauthenticated GET is issued against the liveness path
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response status code is 200, the Content-Type is application/json, and the JSON body's status field equals pass

acceptanceCriteria.description: The liveness probe handler evaluates entirely in-process; a probe hit issues zero network calls to any declared dependency, verifiable by observing the network egress from the probe path.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the process is running and a network-egress observer is attached to the probe path
acceptanceCriteria.when: a GET is issued against the liveness path
acceptanceCriteria.then: the observer records zero egress connections attributable to the probe handler between request receipt and response send

acceptanceCriteria.description: The liveness probe answer is independent of the readiness dependency set: pulling a declared readiness dependency offline never turns the liveness probe fail on its own.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the process is running and every declared readiness dependency is offline
acceptanceCriteria.when: a GET is issued against the liveness path
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response status code is 200 and the JSON body's status field equals pass
